name: Client
definition: A bank customer of the institution, identified by client_id and characterized by gender, birth date, and a residence district.
scope: Analyses about customers, their demographics and their holdings.

name: Account
definition: A bank account held at a branch, identified by account_id and characterized by statement issuance frequency, opening date, and the district of the branch where it was opened.
scope: Analyses of accounts, statement issuance and account holdings.

name: District
definition: A geographic district served by a branch, identified by district_id. Districts are grouped into regions and carry district-level statistics, including an average salary. The same district table is referenced from two different roles: a client's residence and an account's branch.
scope: Geographic grouping and location filtering of accounts and clients.

name: Loan
definition: A credit contract granted on exactly one account, identified by loan_id and characterized by approval date, approved amount, validity duration and contract status.
scope: Analyses of lending, approved amounts and loan performance.

name: Transaction
definition: A financial movement recorded against an account, identified by trans_id and characterized by date, direction type, operation, amount and resulting balance.
scope: Analyses of account activity, cash flows and withdrawals.

name: Disposition
definition: The record that grants a client a role on an account (owner or disponent). It is the only link between clients and accounts.
scope: Resolving which client is related to which account and in which role.

name: Statement Issuance Frequency
definition: The frequency with which account statements are issued, stored on the account as a coded label.
scope: Selecting accounts by their statement issuance preference.

name: Client Gender
definition: The recorded gender of a client, coded as a single letter.
scope: Demographic segmentation of clients.

name: Region
definition: A coarse geographic region that groups the districts into 8 units; carried as the A3 attribute of district.
scope: Geographic aggregation above district level.

name: District Name
definition: The human-readable name of a district; carried as the A2 attribute of district.
scope: Presenting or filtering districts by name.

name: District Average Salary
definition: A district-level average salary statistic carried as the A11 attribute of district. It is a precomputed property of the district, not an aggregation over individual client records.
scope: Filtering or ranking districts by economic level.

name: Account Opening Date
definition: The date on which an account was opened, stored as account.date.
scope: Time-based selection of accounts.

name: Client Birth Date
definition: The recorded date of birth of a client.
scope: Identifying or segmenting clients by birth date or age.

name: Loan Approval Date
definition: The date on which a loan was approved, stored as loan.date.
scope: Time-based selection of loans.

name: Approved Loan Amount
definition: The principal amount approved for a loan, stored as loan.amount.
scope: Loan size comparisons and amount thresholds.

name: Loan Validity Duration
definition: The contractual length of a loan, stored as loan.duration and expressed in months. Workload phrasing such as 'loan validity' refers to this field.
scope: Selecting loans by term length.

name: Loan Contract Status
definition: The coded repayment status of a loan contract, stored as loan.status with the single-letter values A, B, C and D.
scope: Classifying loans as running or finished and by repayment outcome.

name: Transaction Direction Type
definition: The coded direction of a transaction, stored as trans.type with the values PRIJEM, VYDAJ and VYBER.
scope: Separating incoming from outgoing movements.

name: Transaction Operation
definition: The mode of a transaction, stored as trans.operation, distinguishing cash withdrawal, cash deposit, card withdrawal and account-to-account remittances.
scope: Classifying how money moved on an account.

name: Cash Withdrawal
definition: A transaction in which the client withdraws cash. In this data it is identified by the operation code 'VYBER'.
scope: Analyses of cash withdrawals.

name: Transaction Amount
definition: The magnitude of a transaction, stored as trans.amount. Values are non-negative; direction is carried by the transaction direction type rather than by the sign.
scope: Summing or comparing transaction magnitudes.

name: Percentage of a Population Subset
definition: A share expressed as a percentage, computed as the count or total satisfying a condition divided by the count or total of the whole population, multiplied by 100.
scope: Questions asking what percentage of clients or of accounts satisfy a condition.
